mechanism: Pramipexole may reduce norethindrone efficacy through dopaminergic effects on hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis and potential CYP3A4 induction; norethindrone may increase pramipexole levels via CYP metabolism competition.
action: Monitor contraceptive efficacy and consider backup contraception; counsel on breakthrough bleeding risk; assess for increased pramipexole side effects.
